ticket.subject: Feature request: Outlook integration
ticket.body_text:
Hi folks,

I look after our account at Glimmerbrook BV. Could you support Outlook calendar sync? Most of our company is on Microsoft 365.

People currently copy meetings by hand. You can reach me on +1 (303) 555-0110 if a call is quicker.

Could you look into this sometime this week? Please let us know if it is planned.

Thanks so much!
Lars Albright
